name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO for Help Articles?
description: Track local search rankings, organic traffic from specific locations, click-through rates, bounce rates, conversion rates, and engagement metrics.

mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO for Help Articles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key metrics include local search rankings for geo-targeted keywords, organic traffic to help articles from specific geographic locations, and click-through rates. You should also monitor bounce rates on these articles, conversion rates (e.g., users contacting support or making a purchase after viewing an article), and the number of local customer inquiries attributed to your help content. Tracking engagement metrics like time on page can also indicate content effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track local search rankings, organic traffic from specific locations, click-through rates, bounce rates, conversion rates, and engagement metrics.
